payload.summary: Validation issue caps need one coherent shape across scan stopping, returned entries, and sentinel text.
lessons: If validation returns a sentinel within a fixed issue-entry budget, the maximum concrete issue count is one less than the returned entry limit.
Scan-time stopping should collect only enough concrete issues to justify the sentinel instead of doing one extra discarded read.
Tests should assert the sentinel code and message, not only the final array length.
verification: For validation-budget changes, run a malformed-corpus truncation test that checks both the retained issue count and sentinel wording.
